# AI services FQDN block list - HAND-MAINTAINED (not auto-generated).
# Purpose: block common generative-AI chat, API, writing, image/video/audio and coding services at the FortiGate.
# Sources: vendor network/allowlist docs (OpenAI, Google Workspace, Cursor), Nullgen ai-blocklist (2026-10),
#          amnahwaida Pi-hole AI hosts list (2026-03), Netskope/Zscaler/Fortinet community guidance.
# Built: 2026-11-06  -  188 active FQDNs (146 core + 27 optional coding + 15 Anthropic/Claude).
# Published to GitHub TuckerNET/BLOCKLISTS as AI-FQDN.txt (manual push - not in the nightly CISAGitPush).
#
# Format: one FQDN per line, no wildcards, no URLs. Lines starting with # are comments.
# FortiGate domain feeds match each entry EXACTLY (no implied subdomains), so the base domain
# is listed together with the known working hosts under it.
# Shared-infrastructure parents (google.com, googleapis.com, microsoft.com, bing.com, cloud.microsoft,
# facebook.com, x.com, twitter.com, github.com) are deliberately NOT listed - only AI-specific hosts.
# NOTE: google.com / googleapis.com are on the CISA _domain_whitelist.txt. Do not run this file through
#       CISAProcess or the whitelist filter or the Google hosts below will be stripped.
# The Anthropic / Claude section is LAST and ACTIVE - network admin maintains the Cowork allow-policy above it.

# Not listed (shared with thousands of other sites): cdn.workos.com, js.stripe.com, intercom.io,
# challenges.cloudflare.com, statsig.com. ChatGPT Voice also uses UDP 3478 to OpenAI IP ranges
# (chatgpt-voice.json) - a DNS/FQDN block does not stop an already-open voice session.

# ==================== Google Gemini / AI Studio / NotebookLM ====================
# AI-specific hosts only. google.com, googleapis.com, gstatic.com, googleusercontent.com are NOT blocked.
# Gemini inside Search (AI Mode / AI Overviews), Gmail, Docs and Android stays reachable - turn it off
# in the Workspace Admin console for managed accounts.
gemini.google.com
gemini.gstatic.com
bard.google.com
aistudio.google.com
makersuite.google.com
alkalimakersuite-pa.clients6.google.com
notebooklm.google.com
notebooklm.google

robinfrontend-pa.googleapis.com
appsgenaiserver-pa.clients6.google.com
labs.google
deepmind.google
deepmind.com
# Vertex AI API - blocks ALL Vertex model calls (Gemini, and Claude/Llama hosted on Vertex). Disable if any
# internal app or GCP workload uses Vertex.
aiplatform.googleapis.com
# Deliberately NOT listed - Google lists these for Gemini but they are shared anti-abuse / assistant backends
# used by Sign-in, YouTube, Nest and Android Assistant:
#   waa-pa.clients6.google.com, jnn-pa.googleapis.com, assistant.google.com, assistant.googleapis.com,
#   opa-pa.googleapis.com, opa-pa.clients6.google.com

# ==================== Microsoft Copilot (consumer) ====================
# Standalone Copilot site/app only. Copilot inside Word/Excel/Outlook/Teams, Edge sidebar and Windows uses
# shared Microsoft 365 / Bing hosts - disable those with M365 admin, Edge (HubsSidebarEnabled) and Windows policy.
copilot.microsoft.com
sydney.bing.com
# M365 Copilot (work accounts). Microsoft says *.cloud.microsoft must stay reachable and blocking
# individual hosts under it is unsupported. Leave commented unless you intend to block M365 Copilot Chat
# and have tested Outlook/Teams afterwards. m365.cloud.microsoft is the Microsoft 365 app home - do NOT add it.
# copilot.cloud.microsoft

# ==================== Meta AI ====================
# Standalone meta.ai only. Meta AI inside Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp and Messenger shares those apps' hosts.
meta.ai
www.meta.ai
